item.text: I’ll read `crates.json`, ask one child agent to evaluate every pair, then independently check its results and save its report.

item.command: "<PROGRAM_FILES>\\POWERS~1\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$data = Get-Content -Raw crates.json | ConvertFrom-Json; $result = for ($i=0; $i -lt $data.crates.Count; $i++) { for ($j=$i+1; $j -lt $data.crates.Count; $j++) { $a=$data.crates[$i]; $b=$data.crates[$j]; $price=$a.cost_dollars+$b.cost_dollars; $kits=$a.kits+$b.kits; $mats=$a.mats+$b.mats; [pscustomobject]@{Pair=$a.id+$b.id; Price=$price; Kits=$kits; Mats=$mats; Budget=($price -le $data.requirements.budget_dollars); Quantity=($kits -ge $data.requirements.min_kits -and $mats -ge $data.requirements.min_mats); ConfirmedFriday=($a.availability -eq '"'confirmed by Friday' -and "'$b.availability -eq '"'confirmed by Friday')} } }; "'$result | ConvertTo-Json'
